title: Shun Yamaya
text:
Shun Yamaya


I am a Ph.D. candidate in political science at Stanford University. I study American politics, with a focus on political communication, media and technology.


syamaya@stanford.edu Curriculum Vitae

“The Effect of Electoral Inversions on Democratic Legitimacy: Evidence from the United States”  (with John Carey, Gretchen Helmke, Brendan Nyhan, Mitch Sanders, and Susan Stokes)  British Journal of Political Science. August, 2021.  [Replication Archive]
